statements.statement: The member presented with a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered
The service is for ambulatory evaluation
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R55
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The service is clinically necessary to correlate the patient's palpitations and intermittent syncope with cardiac rhythm disturbances
